key_insight: ADAPT-VQE faces symmetry-induced zero gradients and excited-state convergence, but suitable operator pools and initial states can recover target states in a 2+1D lattice field theory.
engineering_relevance: Reliable lattice-field state preparation requires designing operator pools and initial states around symmetries rather than relying on adaptive energy minimization alone.
method: Analyze vanishing gradients for real-valued pool operators when the qubit Hamiltonian and initial state are real.
Apply ADAPT-VQE to free Wilson fermions in 2+1 dimensions.
Incorporate charge-conjugation symmetry and combine different pools with suitable initial states.
evidence_signal: The free-Wilson-fermion case exhibits both failure modes, while tailored pool–initial-state combinations recover the ground and first excited states across the full mass range studied.
watch_item: Success in this free-fermion case does not establish scalability or reliability for interacting higher-dimensional lattice gauge theories.
paper_title: Prospects and limitations of adaptive variational quantum algorithms for lattice field theories: a case study in 2+1 dimensions
